text: Record the cost of hook-driven agent sessions on the ideas they worked on (realizedCostUsd from the session transcript)
description:
Found while settling 675fce29 (2026-11-24): realizedCostUsd only grows from loop-worker harness cycles, but most work on this repo runs through Claude Code (and Codex) sessions driven by the Stop hook, which record nothing. So the calibration (b2a7c3cf) would wait long for 30+ estimate/actual pairs.

Proposal: the Stop hook already gets the session's transcript path. Per turn, sum the token usage in the transcript since the last Stop, price it with harness.json prices (or the CLI's own reported cost where it gives one), and attribute it to the ideas the turn changed (the idea ids in the turn's commits or MCP update calls; split evenly if several). Record via idea.addRealizedCost.

Hypothesis: hook-driven sessions produce most of the realized-cost data within weeks. Refuted if attributing a turn to ideas is too noisy (many ideas per turn, or none).

status.comment: scripts/hooks/record-session-cost.mjs, started by the Stop hook in the background (from the Aimparency checkout named in continue-hook-default; never blocks or fails the hook). Per Stop: transcript lines since the last Stop of that session, usage per model with each API message counted once, priced from .bowman/harness.json (cache read, 5-min and 1-h writes priced separately; an incomplete price records nothing). The cost goes evenly to the ideas the turn changed: files that differ from their state at the last Stop in more than realizedCostUsd (so the recorder's own writes, once committed, don't charge the next turn to the same ideas; fixed in 4d3c0080 after observing it), via POST /idea.addRealizedCost; sums kept to 1e-6 USD. Prices for claude-opus-5-5 are API list rates (claude-api reference, cached 2026-11-03), API-equivalent value on a subscription. Evidence: record-session-cost.test.mjs 4/4 incl. the own-write case; hooks contract PASS; first real records 2026-11-24: $0.5448 on this idea (16:50), $0.6731 over 3 ideas (16:51). Known noise: wrapped agents committing in the same tree within a turn get a share.
